_comment: Omix Market — Maintenance / Transition Mode copy deck. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all maintenance messaging. The React maintenance page (src/pages/Maintenance.jsx) imports this file, and the standalone server fallback page (public/maintenance.html) is generated from it via `node scripts/build-maintenance-page.js` (also runs automatically on `npm run build`). Edit copy here — never hardcode maintenance messages in components.

brand._logoComment: imageSrc is the primary brand logo. logoSvg is the vector fallback (public/omix-mark.svg, generated by scripts/generate-omix-mark.js). tileTheme matches the tile behind raster logos: 'light' for light-background images, 'dark' for dark ones.
